definitions_and_hypotheses_checked: Finite function spaces use maximum norm, so their unit balls and spheres are cubes and cube boundaries.
The half-space chart satisfies ell(b(x))=0 and ell.contLinear(v)=1, not b(x)=0.
The end predicate quantifies C then D then every based loop outside D; its homotopy only has to avoid C.
WeakEndProtectedCore alone does not assert connectedness or spherical type; ConnectedWeakEndCore constructs connected C and selects the containing component.
Complexity is sum of natural subtraction 2*g-1; it has no added carrier terms. Separating compression requires both resulting genera positive.
Disk incompressibility quantifies actual embedded PL disks in R minus C with full frontier preimage exactly the source rim.
The maximal-cut count uses triangular faces, a fixed original model, mod-two first homology, and actual zero-homology components.
Replacement fixes I,J,Lambda,e before its input implications, and quantifies every supplied marked D; it does not construct D for every lattice.
Irreducibility includes the domain's PL condition and a chartwise PL ball for every interior chartwise PL sphere.
The conclusion keeps the same underlying ambient space and requires both PL identity directions only on a protected relative neighborhood.
substantive_proof_mechanisms: Protected compact intersection and connected component selection with literal inherited homotopies.
Minimization over geometric witnesses; cap-piece Euler change; strict measure decrease including separating disks and retained subfamilies.
Actual marked cut filling and disk projection eliminate the nonspherical alternative.
Connected tail selects an actual component; complement is compact and connected; bicollar selects whole original spheres.
Proper arc with two feet, exact boundary pasting, refilling, and strong induction on positive sphere count.
Independent component and graph-cycle homology bounds coupled to original-model exceptional-component geometry.
Maximal no-punctured-component cuts, cap avoidance, exclusion of two new ports, single-port PL ball filling.
Zero-index conjugation, index-one minimum nonbounding sphere/minimum disk and exact spanning contact surgery, index-two same-index cocore escape.
